You can find that most of the small and medium-sized businesses are inclined towards cloud ERP and cloud-based CRM systems to manage operations and gain insightful data to improve them. According to a Forrester study, almost 67% of SMBs have already migrated to a cloud system, and almost 26% are still planning to adapt.

If you are among those who are still thinking about migrating to a cloud system, then you must go through this article to understand the benefits of cloud ERP with integrated CRM, AI, and more. We will also discuss the key factors to find the right cloud CRM for SMBs and modern ERP, along with the process to ease the digital transformation journey for your business.

What Is the Modern Cloud ERP for SMBs?

ERP stands for Enterprise Resource Planning, which serves as a way to handle various business operations, all from one unified platform. This approach often covers things like production scheduling and supply chain management. It also includes customer relationship management, which is known as CRM. Warehouse management fits in there, too. Accounting and human resource management, or HRM, come along with other connected tasks.

The ERP software was initially designed for on-premises environments, which require expensive IT infrastructure to work and store data. Taking it one step ahead, the modern ERP solutions are cloud-based, which are self-hosted and reduce the technological skill gaps and resource overhead.

What Is a Native Cloud CRM for SMBs?

Cloud-based CRM systems offer a flexible way to handle things like tracking customer interactions. It lets you manage sales data and work on feedback to boost service delivery. With cloud-first CRM tools, you store customer contact info and track leads easily. Businesses can identify sales opportunities this way. They can also adjust marketing campaigns to make them more effective.

Small and medium-sized businesses, or SMBs, sometimes deal with outdated on-premises systems or old legacy software. Switching to a cloud-based CRM helps streamline how they manage customers.It brings an updated setup that is secure and ready for compliance needs.

Why Moving to Modern ERP and Cloud-based CRM Systems Makes Sense

1. Remote Access To Data

The companies relying on legacy ERP systems and on-premises CRM are still dependent on office infrastructure to access any data while visiting and opening the system. Modern ERP solutions, hosted on vendors’ systems, provide you with the facility to navigate the resources using a single dashboard while connecting through the internet.

An experienced cloud consultant can offer you cross-device accessibility, allowing you to access necessary information just using your phone at anytime and anywhere you want, and make crucial decisions on the go.

2. Scalable With AI Modules

Modern ERP solutions are powered by artificial intelligence, ML, and more to handle your business operations. The use of predictive AI integrated with your ERP and CRM helps automate your analytics process and gain insightful data about the market trends and customer behavior.

You also get access to customized AI models that help you handle repetitive tasks like accounting, employee tracking, customer interaction, and production scheduling, and gain insights to make better decisions.

3. Real-Time Control Over Stock Level

Cloud ERP for SMBs helps you manage inventory management with real-time analytics for stock allocation. You can monitor your inventory level in multiple warehouses using a single dashboard and set up a smart alert system for stock reduction and overflow.

You can immediately take action for sales and purchases for the resource requirement, allocate the product to different locations, and optimize the best-performing stocks.

4. Centralized Platform for Effective Collaboration

Centralized platforms make collaboration work better in cloud-first systems. They use centralized data storage, so you see all activities on one screen. You integrate tools like Microsoft Teams (formerly Skype) and SharePoint for smooth communication between departments. Sharing documents and info becomes straightforward. You access the newest data from any device via a secure connection.

5. Seamless Integration to E-Commerce Platforms

Seamless ties to e-commerce platforms help with sales in small and medium businesses. Cloud ERP and CRM solutions connect easily to sites like Amazon and Shopify. This lets you handle orders and inventory through a central ERP system. You track leads and gain sales insights. You identify top sellers and underperformers, then adjust campaigns using modern ERP and cloud-based CRM systems.

6. Better Data Insights and Reporting

You can get integrated advanced reporting and analytics tools to measure KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) with cloud-hosted modern ERP solutions to smooth your business operations.

Built-in smart agents and a central dashboard give real-time access to sales data. You see trends, customer feedback, and performance metrics right away. Such info helps spot upsell chances and enhance customer experiences. You respond to market changes and make solid decisions based on them.

7. Real-Time Customer Interaction with AI Chatbots

Modern cloud CRM for SMBs integrated with synthetic intelligence tools like AI chatbots can automate your customer interaction process in real time. You can get a customized chatbot backed by NLP and machine learning technology to communicate with your customers in a human-like language. One of the main benefits of cloud CRM is to improve your customer retention while providing instant solutions to their queries and increasing trust in you.

8. Easy Maintenance with Managed Services

Legacy software needs a dedicated IT team to manage the resources and tools while maintaining the expensive technical setup. Cloud ERP for SMBs, managed by certified partners, requires a low cost for maintenance with no overhead. You get regular updates on the resources, machinery, performance, and predictive maintenance to minimize downtime at your business.

9. Enterprise-Level Protection

Choosing cloud ERP and CRM software integrated with AI and intelligent agents’ helps you in maintaining security and regulatory compliance. The use of predictive AI keeps you updated with industry changes in real time and provides a secure environment for your stakeholders.

Custom cloud providers offer tailored solutions with compliance-ready setups. They help strengthen customer relationships, too. These systems protect key data from risks like anti-money laundering threats. They keep you in line with rules such as GDPR.

10. Affordable Pricing Models

The cloud ERP for SMBs comes with a subscription-based module to access resources and tools as per your operational needs. It means you need to pay only for those tools when you actually need them and decline your subscription whenever you want.

You can even compare the subscription plan that you have chosen as per the resources included and select the best cloud solution that is tailored according to your business needs.

What Features to Consider When Choosing the Modern Cloud System

Enterprise Resource Planning systems are no longer meant to handle accounting operations. You should opt for the cloud-first ERP solutions with integrated CRM evolving with advanced technologies to meet the dynamic market changes and customer behavior.

Here are the key features to get a compliance-ready cloud system that offers scalability and security with improved customer satisfaction.

  • Mobile Responsive: Mobile responsiveness matters in custom cloud systems. Choose one that works well on mobile devices. It enables you and your team to share data anytime. You communicate across departments and pull insights from anywhere.
  • Automation Capabilities: Automation features stand out in tailored cloud ERP for SMBs. Look for one with smooth AI elements like advanced analytics and smart agents. They adapt to trends easily and handle repetitive tasks automatically. You get real-time insights without much effort.
  • Modular System: Go for the modular ERP system that provides flexibility to choose the resources or virtual machine that aligns with your business needs.
  • API Integration: Your modern ERP solutions and cloud-native CRM should provide flexibility to integrate third-party applications and technologies for streamlined operations.
  • Security System: Choose the cloud ERP solution that offers advanced security options like predictive AI and intelligent agents to predict threats before they occur and help you take action to mitigate the risk.
